blocks.text: 更大的模型撞上了内存墙。模型权重占用存储空间，生成时必须读取，会与操作系统和其他应用争抢有限的内存和带宽。即便经过激进压缩的 35B 模型，也可能需要约 20GB 内存，远超手机所能提供的水平。

blocks.text: 我们同时设计了 Edge0-145B 及其推理引擎，以减少让大模型难以在本地运行的内存占用和数据搬运。设计涵盖架构、训练、加载和调度。

inlines.text: 我们同时设计了 Edge0-145B 及其推理引擎，以减少让大模型难以在本地运行的内存占用和数据搬运。设计涵盖架构、训练、加载和调度。

blocks.text: 架构：在稀疏专家之间共享大矩阵。共享矩阵能大幅减少需要存储和搬运的权重，同时保持专家数量不变。每 64 个专家共享两个大矩阵，每个专家则保留一小组参数来体现自身差异。此前，每个专家都存储一整套矩阵。在模型 145B 的总参数中，每次推理步骤只有约 10B 参与计算。

blocks.text: 训练：从第一天起就为本地执行而构建。我们从一开始就按端侧架构训练模型，把部署约束融入设计。这样就无需在训练完云端模型后，再把本地部署当作压缩或剪枝步骤来处理。

blocks.text: 加载：让 GPU 内存、系统内存和 SSD 访问形成流水线。读取和计算在三个存储层级之间重叠进行，避免串行等待。常用的“热专家”常驻 GPU 内存。约 40GB 的专家库放在系统内存中，按需将专家调入 GPU 内存。约 48GB 的词表数据存放在 SSD 上，按需读取。

blocks.text: 调度：让 CPU 和 GPU 协同工作。GPU 计算已缓存的专家，CPU 并行处理剩余工作。投机解码一次验证多个候选 token，把读取权重的成本分摊到更多输出 token 上。这些选择支撑了所报告的 80+ tokens/s 解码速度。

blocks.text: Under the Hood of Edge0: Four Layers of Model and Inference Design

inlines.text: Under the Hood of Edge0: Four Layers of Model and Inference Design

blocks.text: We designed Edge0-145B and its inference engine together to reduce the memory and data movement that make large models difficult to run locally. The design spans architecture, training, loading, and scheduling.

inlines.text: We designed Edge0-145B and its inference engine together to reduce the memory and data movement that make large models difficult to run locally. The design spans architecture, training, loading, and scheduling.

blocks.text: Architecture: share large matrices across sparse experts. Sharing matrices substantially reduces the weights that must be stored and moved while keeping the expert count unchanged. Each group of 64 experts shares two large matrices, while each expert retains a small set of parameters that captures its differences. Previously, every expert stored a complete set of matrices. Of the model's 145B total parameters, only approximately 10B participate in computation on each inference step.

inlines.text: Architecture: share large matrices across sparse experts.

Sharing matrices substantially reduces the weights that must be stored and moved while keeping the expert count unchanged. Each group of 64 experts shares two large matrices, while each expert retains a small set of parameters that captures its differences. Previously, every expert stored a complete set of matrices. blocks.text: Training: build for local execution from day one. We train the model in its on-device architecture from the outset, with deployment constraints built into its design. This avoids treating local deployment as a compression or pruning step after training a cloud model.

blocks.text: Loading: pipeline GPU memory, system memory, and SSD access. Reading and computation overlap across three storage tiers, avoiding serial waits. Frequently used “hot experts” remain in GPU memory. An expert library of approximately 40GB sits in system memory, with experts brought into GPU memory as needed. Approximately 48GB of vocabulary data resides on the SSD and is read on demand.

blocks.text: Scheduling: use the CPU and GPU together. The GPU computes cached experts while the CPU handles the remaining work in parallel. Speculative decoding verifies multiple candidate tokens at once, spreading the cost of reading weights across more output tokens. These choices support the reported 80+ tokens/s decode rate.

inlines.text: Local execution addresses four practical obstacles to adopting cloud-only AI:
Control cloud-model costs.
Local inference adds no corresponding cloud-model token or API fees as usage grows.
Keep sensitive data local.
Code, documents, and business records can stay on the hardware, giving teams control over data handling.
Sustain a responsive experience.
Model and inference-engine design address response speed, power use, system responsiveness, and continuous operation together.
Keep core capabilities available offline.
